import hashlib, json, os, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

p = Path(__file__).parent
root = p / 'profiles'
root.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
metadata = json.loads((p / 'metadata.json').read_text())
cases = ['wide_projection_ansitrue', 'correlated_count_ansitrue']
records = []
for i, variant in enumerate(['before', 'after', 'after', 'before'] * 2):
    binary = Path(metadata['binaries'][variant]['path'])
    assert hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == metadata['binaries'][variant]['sha256']
    for case in cases:
        out = root / f'{i:02}-{variant}-{case}'
        out.mkdir()
        for name in ['control', 'ack']:
            os.mkfifo(out / name)
        cmd = ['perf', 'record', '--delay=-1', f'--control=fifo:{out}/control,{out}/ack', '-e', 'cycles:u', '-c', '100003', '-o', str(out / 'perf.data'), '--', 'taskset', '-c', '2', str(binary), str(out / 'capture.json'), 'subqueries', case]
        env = os.environ | {'DECIMAL_BENCH_RETAIN': 'none', 'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_DIR': str(out), 'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_PHASE': 'execution'}
        run = subprocess.run(cmd, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=120)
        report = subprocess.check_output(['perf', 'report', '--stdio', '--no-children', '--show-nr-samples', '--sort=symbol', '--percent-limit', '0.5', '-t', ';', '-i', str(out / 'perf.data')], text=True, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        (out / 'report.txt').write_text(report)
        capture = json.loads((out / 'capture.json').read_text())
        assert len(capture['results']) == 1 and capture['results'][0]['status'] == 'ok'
        expected = next(r for r in json.loads((p.parent / 'decimal-double-dispatch-4826390' / f'{variant}-subquery-check.json').read_text())['results'] if r['id'] == case)
        assert all(capture['results'][0][k] == v for k, v in expected.items())
        records.append({'variant': variant, 'case': case, 'command': cmd, 'environment': {k: env[k] for k in ['DECIMAL_BENCH_RETAIN', 'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_DIR', 'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_PHASE']}, 'capture': capture, 'stderr': run.stderr, 'report': report, 'data_path': str(out / 'perf.data')})
        print(i, variant, case, flush=True)
        (p / 'profiles.json').write_text(json.dumps({'scope': 'Execution-only self-cycle profiles of frozen binaries. Four fresh processes per variant/case, period100003. Profile timings are diagnostic and excluded from performance comparisons. No source rebuild.', 'runs': records}, indent=2) + '\n')

import hashlib, json, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

p = Path(__file__).parent
old = p.parent / 'decimal-double-dispatch-4826390'
sha = lambda f: hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
source = p / 'decimal_bench.rs'
assert sha(source) == json.loads((old / 'built.json').read_text())['runtime']['decimal_bench.rs']
artifacts = [json.loads(line) for line in (old / 'cargo.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
target = p.parent / 'integer-widening-sparse-owned-542a847/target/release'
sysroot = subprocess.check_output(['rustc', '--print', 'sysroot'], text=True).strip()
linker = p / 'capture-linker.py'
linker.chmod(0o755)
command = ['rustc', '--crate-name', 'decimal_bench', '--edition=2024', '-C', 'opt-level=3',
           '-C', 'embed-bitcode=no', '-C', 'save-temps=yes', '-C', 'linker-flavor=gcc',
           '-C', f'linker={linker}', '-C', 'link-arg=-fuse-ld=lld',
           '-C', f'link-arg=-B{sysroot}/lib/rustlib/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin/gcc-ld',
           '-L', f'dependency={target / "deps"}']
libraries = {}
names = ['arrow', 'datafusion', 'delta_arrow_reader', 'futures_util', 'sail_common',
         'sail_common_datafusion', 'sail_plan', 'sail_sql_analyzer', 'serde_json', 'tokio',
         'delta_kernel', 'parquet']
for name in names:
    rows = [r for r in artifacts if r.get('reason') == 'compiler-artifact' and r['target']['name'] == name]
    assert len(rows) == 1, (name, len(rows))
    library = next(Path(f) for f in rows[0]['filenames'] if f.endswith('.rlib'))
    command += ['--extern', f'{name}={library}']
    libraries[str(library)] = sha(library)
for path in sorted({path for r in artifacts if r.get('reason') == 'build-script-executed' for path in r.get('linked_paths', [])}):
    command += ['-L', path]
command += [str(source), '-o', str(p / 'layout-default')]
with (p / 'layout-build.log').open('w') as out:
    subprocess.run(command, cwd=p, check=True, stdout=out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
link = json.loads((p / 'link-command.json').read_text())
records = [{'name': 'layout-default', 'sha256': sha(p / 'layout-default'), 'command': command}]
for seed in [1, 2, 3, 4]:
    binary = p / f'layout-{seed}'
    cmd = link.copy()
    cmd[cmd.index('-o') + 1] = str(binary)
    cmd += [f'-Wl,--shuffle-sections=.text.*={seed}']
    subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=p, check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    records.append({'name': binary.name, 'sha256': sha(binary), 'command': cmd})
    print('Linked layout', seed, flush=True)
result = {'scope': 'Diagnostic links of one compiled benchmark object and the same dependency libraries. No runtime patch or production linker setting.',
          'source_sha256': sha(source), 'libraries': libraries, 'records': records}
(p / 'layout-build.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')

replay = []
for arg in sys.argv[1:]:
    if arg.startswith('/tmp/rustc') and Path(arg).is_file():
        target = saved / Path(arg).name
        shutil.copy2(arg, target)
        replay.append(str(target))

        replay.append(arg)

import hashlib, json, re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

p = Path(__file__).parent
sha = lambda f: hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
metadata = json.loads((p / 'metadata.json').read_text())
build = json.loads((p / 'layout-build.json').read_text())
assert all(sha(Path(f)) == h for f, h in build['libraries'].items())
binaries = {k: Path(r['path']) for k, r in metadata['binaries'].items()}
binaries.update({r['name']: p / r['name'] for r in build['records']})
summary = json.loads((p / 'profile-summary.json').read_text())['groups']
names = [row['symbol'].removeprefix('[.] ') for group in summary if group['variant'] == 'before'
         for row in group['top_symbols'][:4 if group['case'] == 'wide_projection_ansitrue' else 2]]
symbols = {}
for name, binary in binaries.items():
    matches = {n: [] for n in names}
    for line in subprocess.check_output(['nm', '-S', '-C', str(binary)], text=True).splitlines():
        row = line.split(maxsplit=3)
        if len(row) != 4 or row[3] not in matches:
            continue
        matches[row[3]].append({'start': int(row[0], 16), 'size': int(row[1], 16), 'name': row[3]})
    assert all(len(rows) == 1 for rows in matches.values()), (name, {n: len(rows) for n, rows in matches.items()})
    records = []
    for index, (symbol, matches) in enumerate(matches.items()):
        row = matches[0]
        start, end = row['start'], row['start'] + row['size']
        cmd = ['objdump', '-d', '-C', '--no-show-raw-insn', f'--start-address={start}', f'--stop-address={end}', str(binary)]
        asm = subprocess.check_output(cmd, text=True)
        (p / f'{name}-hot-{index}.asm').write_text(asm)
        instructions = []
        for line in asm.splitlines():
            match = re.match(r'\s*([0-9a-f]+):\s+(.+)', line)
            if not match:
                continue
            instruction = re.split(r'\s+#\s+', match[2], maxsplit=1)[0]
            instruction = re.sub(r'-?0x[0-9a-f]+\(%rip\)', 'RIP_DISPLACEMENT(%rip)', instruction)
            branch = re.fullmatch(r'(j\w+|call)\s+([0-9a-f]+) <(.*)>', instruction)
            if branch:
                target = int(branch[2], 16)
                instruction = branch[1] + ' ' + (f'local+{target-start:x}' if start <= target < end else branch[3])
            instructions.append(f'{int(match[1],16)-start:x}: {" ".join(instruction.split())}')
        records.append(row | {'modulo_64': start % 64, 'modulo_4096': start % 4096,
                             'instructions': instructions, 'command': cmd, 'assembly_sha256': hashlib.sha256(asm.encode()).hexdigest()})
    symbols[name] = {'binary_sha256': sha(binary), 'functions': records}
    print('Inspected', name, flush=True)
for name, record in symbols.items():
    for expected, actual in zip(symbols['before']['functions'], record['functions'], strict=True):
        assert expected['name'] == actual['name']
        assert expected['instructions'] == actual['instructions'], (name, actual['name'])
canonical = json.loads((p.parent / 'decimal-double-dispatch-4826390/after-subquery-check.json').read_text())
captures = {}
for name, binary in binaries.items():
    if name in metadata['binaries']:
        continue
    output = p / f'{name}-check.json'
    subprocess.run([str(binary), str(output), 'subquery-check'], check=True, capture_output=True)
    assert json.loads(output.read_text()) == canonical, name
    captures[name] = {'sha256': sha(output), 'queries': len(canonical['results'])}
    print('Validated', name, flush=True)
result = {'normalization': 'Relative instruction offsets, branch targets and named external calls; RIP-relative displacements and comments omitted. This checks instruction shape, not byte identity or equal hardware behavior.',
          'binaries': symbols, 'captures': captures}
(p / 'layout-validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')

import json, os, statistics, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

p = Path(__file__).parent
output = p / 'layout-measurements'
output.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
validation = json.loads((p / 'layout-validation.json').read_text())
meta = json.loads((p / 'metadata.json').read_text())
binaries = {name: Path(row['path']) for name, row in meta['binaries'].items()}
binaries.update({name: p / name for name in validation['captures']})
canonical = {r['id']: r for r in json.loads((p / 'layout-default-check.json').read_text())['results']}
cases = ['wide_projection_ansitrue', 'correlated_count_ansitrue']
variants = list(binaries)
runs = []
assert not any(k.startswith(('MALLOC_', 'GLIBC_', 'LD_PRELOAD', 'DECIMAL_BENCH_')) for k in os.environ)
for cycle in range(4):
    order = variants if cycle % 2 == 0 else variants[::-1]
    for variant in order:
        for case in cases[cycle % 2:] + cases[:cycle % 2]:
            d = output / f'{cycle}-{variant}-{case}'
            d.mkdir()
            for name in ['control', 'ack']:
                os.mkfifo(d / name)
            command = ['perf', 'stat', '--delay=-1', f'--control=fifo:{d}/control,{d}/ack',
                       '--json-output', '-o', str(d / 'counters.jsonl'), '-e',
                       '{instructions:u,cycles:u,ic_tag_hit_miss.instruction_cache_miss:u,ic_tag_hit_miss.all_instruction_cache_accesses:u},task-clock:u,context-switches:u,cpu-migrations:u,page-faults:u',
                       '--', 'taskset', '-c', '2', str(binaries[variant]), str(d / 'capture.json'), 'subqueries', case]
            env = os.environ | {'DECIMAL_BENCH_RETAIN': 'none', 'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_DIR': str(d), 'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_PHASE': 'execution'}
            process = subprocess.run(command, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=120)
            capture = json.loads((d / 'capture.json').read_text())['results'][0]
            assert all(capture[k] == value for k, value in canonical[case].items())
            assert capture['retention'] == 'none' and capture['retained_rows'] == 0
            counters = [json.loads(line) for line in (d / 'counters.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('{')]
            assert len(counters) == 8 and all(row['pcnt-running'] == 100 for row in counters)
            assert process.stderr.count('Events enabled') == 1 and len(capture['samples_ms']) == 9
            runs.append({'cycle': cycle, 'variant': variant, 'case': case, 'command': command,
                         'capture': capture, 'counters': counters, 'median_ms': statistics.median(capture['samples_ms'])})
        print(cycle, variant, flush=True)
    (p / 'layout-measurements.json').write_text(json.dumps({'cases': cases, 'variants': variants, 'runs': runs}, indent=2) + '\n')
summary = {}
for case in cases:
    summary[case] = {}
    for variant in variants:
        rows = [r for r in runs if r['case'] == case and r['variant'] == variant]
        counts = {c['event']: statistics.median(float(next(x['counter-value'] for x in r['counters'] if x['event'] == c['event'])) for r in rows) for c in rows[0]['counters']}
        summary[case][variant] = {'median_ms': statistics.median(r['median_ms'] for r in rows),
                                  'process_medians_ms': [r['median_ms'] for r in rows], 'counters': counts}
    print(case, {k: v['median_ms'] for k, v in summary[case].items()}, flush=True)
(p / 'layout-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + '\n')

import json, os, statistics, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

p = Path(__file__).parent
root = p / 'syscalls'
root.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
tracer = p.parent / 'integral-allocator-2cc3024/tools/strace'
records = []
for i, variant in enumerate(['before', 'after', 'after', 'before']):
    mode = 'none'
    out = root / f'{i:02}-{variant}'
    out.mkdir()
    for name in ['control', 'ack']:
        os.mkfifo(out / name)
    bench = [str(p.parent / 'decimal-double-dispatch-4826390' / f'{variant}-bench'), str(out / 'capture.json'), 'subqueries', 'correlated_count_ansitrue']
    trace = [str(tracer), '-f', '-qq', '--seccomp-bpf', '-ttt', '-T', '-yy', '-e', 'trace=brk,mmap,munmap,madvise,write', '-o', str(out / 'syscalls.txt'), *bench]
    cmd = ['perf', 'stat', '--delay=-1', f'--control=fifo:{out}/control,{out}/ack', '--json-output', '-o', str(out / 'counters.jsonl'), '-e', 'page-faults:u', '--', 'taskset', '-c', '2', *trace]
    env = os.environ | {'DECIMAL_BENCH_RETAIN': mode, 'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_DIR': str(out), 'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_PHASE': 'execution'}
    run = subprocess.run(cmd, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=120)
    (out / 'stderr.txt').write_text(run.stderr)
    lines = (out / 'syscalls.txt').read_text().splitlines()
    starts = [j for j, s in enumerate(lines) if '"enable\\n"' in s and '/control>' in s]
    ends = [j for j, s in enumerate(lines) if '"disable\\n"' in s and '/control>' in s]
    assert len(starts) == len(ends) == 1, (starts, ends)
    interval = lines[starts[0] + 1:ends[0]]
    calls = {name: [s for s in interval if f' {name}(' in s] for name in ['brk', 'mmap', 'munmap', 'madvise']}
    cap = json.loads((out / 'capture.json').read_text())
    assert len(cap['results']) == 1 and cap['results'][0]['status'] == 'ok'
    expected = next(r for r in json.loads((p.parent / 'decimal-double-dispatch-4826390/after-subquery-check.json').read_text())['results'] if r['id'] == 'correlated_count_ansitrue')
    assert all(cap['results'][0][k] == v for k, v in expected.items())
    record = {'variant': variant, 'mode': mode, 'case': 'correlated_count_ansitrue', 'command': cmd, 'capture': cap, 'counts': {k: len(v) for k, v in calls.items()}, 'examples': {k: v[:4] + v[-4:] if len(v) > 8 else v for k, v in calls.items()}, 'trace_path': str(out / 'syscalls.txt'), 'marker_lines': [lines[starts[0]], lines[ends[0]]], 'median_ms_with_tracing': statistics.median(cap['results'][0]['samples_ms'])}
    records.append(record)
    print(i, mode, record['counts'], flush=True)
    (p / 'syscall-runs.json').write_text(json.dumps({'scope': 'Four fixed diagnostic processes, not performance samples. strace perturbs execution. Memory syscall counts cover only the enable/disable interval; perf counts include the tracer and are not used in untraced comparisons.', 'runs': records}, indent=2) + '\n')

    for name in ['control', 'ack']:
        os.mkfifo(out / name)
    bench = [str(p.parent / 'decimal-double-dispatch-4826390' / f'{variant}-bench'), str(out / 'capture.json'), 'subqueries', 'correlated_count_ansitrue']
    trace = [str(tracer), '-f', '-qq', '--seccomp-bpf', '-ttt', '-T', '-yy', '-e', 'trace=brk,mmap,munmap,madvise,write', '-o', str(out / 'syscalls.txt'), *bench]
    cmd = ['perf', 'stat', '--delay=-1', f'--control=fifo:{out}/control,{out}/ack', '--json-output', '-o', str(out / 'counters.jsonl'), '-e', 'page-faults:u', '--', 'taskset', '-c', '2', *trace]
    env = os.environ | {'MALLOC_MMAP_MAX_': '0', 'MALLOC_TRIM_THRESHOLD_': '1073741824', 'DECIMAL_BENCH_RETAIN': mode, 'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_DIR': str(out), 'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_PHASE': 'execution'}
    run = subprocess.run(cmd, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=120)
    (out / 'stderr.txt').write_text(run.stderr)
    lines = (out / 'syscalls.txt').read_text().splitlines()
    starts = [j for j, s in enumerate(lines) if '"enable\\n"' in s and '/control>' in s]
    ends = [j for j, s in enumerate(lines) if '"disable\\n"' in s and '/control>' in s]
    assert len(starts) == len(ends) == 1, (starts, ends)
    interval = lines[starts[0] + 1:ends[0]]
    calls = {name: [s for s in interval if f' {name}(' in s] for name in ['brk', 'mmap', 'munmap', 'madvise']}
    cap = json.loads((out / 'capture.json').read_text())
    assert len(cap['results']) == 1 and cap['results'][0]['status'] == 'ok'
    expected = next(r for r in json.loads((p.parent / 'decimal-double-dispatch-4826390/after-subquery-check.json').read_text())['results'] if r['id'] == 'correlated_count_ansitrue')
    assert all(cap['results'][0][k] == v for k, v in expected.items())
    record = {'variant': variant, 'mode': mode, 'environment_overrides': {'MALLOC_MMAP_MAX_': '0', 'MALLOC_TRIM_THRESHOLD_': '1073741824'}, 'case': 'correlated_count_ansitrue', 'command': cmd, 'capture': cap, 'counts': {k: len(v) for k, v in calls.items()}, 'examples': {k: v[:4] + v[-4:] if len(v) > 8 else v for k, v in calls.items()}, 'trace_path': str(out / 'syscalls.txt'), 'marker_lines': [lines[starts[0]], lines[ends[0]]], 'median_ms_with_tracing': statistics.median(cap['results'][0]['samples_ms'])}
    records.append(record)
    print(i, mode, record['counts'], flush=True)
    (p / 'retained-syscall-runs.json').write_text(json.dumps({'scope': 'Four fixed diagnostic processes, not performance samples. strace perturbs execution. Memory syscall counts cover only the enable/disable interval; perf counts include the tracer and are not used in untraced comparisons.', 'runs': records}, indent=2) + '\n')

sources.use: Documented allocation threshold and mmap count controls.
Per-process environment aliases for the diagnostic allocation controls.

conclusions: The original wide-query ~1% difference remains reproducible. Six normalized hot functions are unchanged; diagnostic links of the same objects and libraries place the wide control on both sides of the old baseline. This supports layout sensitivity without identifying a unique cache mechanism.

COUNT latency changes sign across default series while user instruction counts stay nearly unchanged. Its slow processes correlate with page faults, and separate traces show repeated heap shrinking/regrowth in both binaries.

Pinning both allocation thresholds to 1 MiB leaves COUNT faults and slow modes. The stronger diagnostic setting removes observed heap shrinking and most faults; the old/new median gap then measures about 0.44% in this series.
These findings do not establish universal zero overhead or a production allocator fix. The negative-scale patch remains experimental; full Spark compatibility is unchanged.
